title: Entry Level & Experienced Technicians - Construction Materials Testing
abstract: Start your career or bring your testing experience closer to home. Join our Gold Coast team for hands-on lab and field work in a long-term role.
bullets: Get trained on work time – Learn on the job
Fantastic workplace in a great location, with a supportive and friendly team

content_text:
Butler Partners Regional is hiring entry-level and experienced Construction Materials Testing Technicians to join our Gold Coast team.
Ready to move on from FIFO and spend more time at home? If you’re an experienced technician looking for a stable, long-term role, you’ll be based at our Currumbin Waters laboratory and work on local projects, with travel as required.
If you’re new to construction materials testing, we’ll help you get started with hands-on training and support from experienced technicians.
About us
Butler Partners Regional is an established geotechnical, geo-environmental and groundwater consultancy and construction materials testing provider. We’re known for the quality of our work and the technical expertise of our team. Across seven offices, the Butler Partners Group works with major clients on projects in mining and resources, infrastructure, and commercial, industrial and residential development. We help clients tackle complex challenges in both built and natural environments.
About the role
Working with the Laboratory Manager and the wider team, you’ll:
- Collect and prepare samples and carry out laboratory and field testing.
- Record results accurately and complete assigned work on time.
- Support local projects and assist with remote projects when required.
- Follow company safety and quality procedures and keep work areas clean and tidy.
What you’ll need
- A current driver’s licence.
- A Construction White Card or willingness to obtain one.
- Ability to pass drug and alcohol screening.
- Ability to carry out manual work, including repeated lifting.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Willingness to travel and work flexible hours when required.
Why join us?
- Learn on the job with support from experienced staff.
- Build your skills through external training courses completed during work hours.
- Gain experience across a range of projects with a mix of laboratory and field work.
